Hello.

I'm Muhammad Zair Ali, a graphic designer who loves turning ideas into clean, eye-catching visuals. From social media designs and brand identities to presentations and marketing materials, I focus on creating designs that look great and communicate the right message.

My process combines creativity with attention to detail. I mainly work with Canva, Adobe Illustrator, and Photoshop, creating visuals that reflect each brand's personality while keeping the design polished, purposeful, and engaging.

What I do

  • Brand identity & logo design
  • Social media & marketing graphics
  • Infographics & data visualization
  • Presentation & report design
  • Print & packaging design
  • Posters, flyers & brochures
  • Business cards & stationery
  • YouTube thumbnails & cover art
  • Digital ads & promotional creatives
  • Canva templates & editable designs
  • Pitch decks & corporate profiles
  • Layout design & typography

Hello.

I'm Muhammad Zair Ali, a video editor who enjoys turning raw footage into engaging, polished videos. From social media reels and video ads to YouTube content and promotional videos, I love creating edits that capture attention and tell a story.

My editing process focuses on pacing, transitions, sound, and visuals that keep viewers engaged. I use a mix of creative storytelling and attention to detail to make every video feel smooth, purposeful, and suited to its audience.

What I do

  • Social media reels & short-form videos
  • YouTube video editing
  • Video ads & promotional content
  • Brand & product videos
  • Corporate & business videos
  • Instagram & TikTok content
  • Motion graphics & animated text
  • Transitions, effects & visual storytelling
  • Color correction & color grading
  • Sound design & audio enhancement
  • Subtitles & captions
  • Long-form video editing
  • Documentary & cinematic edits
  • Podcast & talking-head videos
  • Faceless YouTube videos & automation content
